scenario.title: Battle of Athens
intro.text:
BATTLE OF ATHENS - 12 DEC 1944

Athens, Greece

In Athens the Communists are gone over to armed struggle! At present, we have insufficient forces stationed in Athens, but the British have pledged to fly in the 4th Indian Division from Italy immediately. Beat back the communists and clear Athens and the surrounding areas from the rebels!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE In this mission the AI has the first turn!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-16-0-briliant.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.reaction-16-0-briliant.text: The brigade took Rimini before the defenders could withdraw in order. Now it has a new name and politicians requesting its services. Send those requests to me. The battalions need to refit first.
line.reaction-16-1-victory-tactical.text: Rimini is taken. The ceremony is being arranged, but the fighting left considerable damage. I'll make sure the situation report reaches the officials before the photographs do.
line.callback-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.callback-0.text: The brigade remembers the airfield turn. At the ceremony they spoke only about the flag in Rimini. Let the engineers give their account before the next briefing; the new officers should hear it.
line.callback-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.callback-1.text: The coastal batteries reached Rimini on time. Allied headquarters would like to use the same arrangements again. I need to see where that puts the brigade before I agree.
line.mutiny-force-precedent.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.mutiny-force-precedent.text: ELAS studied what we did in the Egyptian barracks. They know we take wireless sets and arsenals before we ask men to surrender. I would have studied us too.
line.mutiny-corridor-precedent.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.mutiny-corridor-precedent.text: The Egyptian corridors worked because the men believed surrender would not hand them to private revenge. I argued for the same restraint here. I cannot promise the same trust.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.earned-decision.text: The Rimini engineers are assembled in the yard with their tools packed. They can enter Athens as a company, or disappear into battalions which all claim to need them first.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-rimini-: Keep the Rimini engineers as a separate assault detachment.
Add an experienced seven-strength 1944 engineer detachment.
line.earned-decision.choice.spread-rimin: Distribute the engineers and replacements through the brigade.
Give infantry 15 experience and restore the core to at least nine strength with full ammunition.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.earned-a-response.text: Keep the company. In Italy they opened bunkers; here they will open barricades and, if we are careful, roads out of them.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.earned-b-response.text: Send the engineers and stores to the battalions that need them. Tell the men where they've gone; we don't need another rumour about why a Rimini company was broken up.
line.scene-0.speaker: Lieutenant-General Ronald Scobie
line.scene-0.text: Piraeus, the airfields, and central Athens are to be secured. ELAS is to disarm. All forces in this theatre come under my command; I will not negotiate that point street by street.
line.scene-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-1.text: A note came from Markou in the western districts. The hospitals are taking both uniforms, families are sleeping in basements, and neither side believes the other's white cloth.
line.scene-2.speaker: Lieutenant-General Ronald Scobie
line.scene-2.text: A humanitarian report is not an operational plan, Sergeant.
line.scene-3.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-3.text: It tells us where the hospitals are and why people won't trust a white flag. We need that information if we're going to get anyone to surrender, General.
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: Do we accept Scobie's full fire and supply plan, or restrict heavy weapons and mark hospital and civilian corridors even if ELAS uses the pause?
line.decision.choice.accept-scobies-cont: Accept Scobie's operational plan and full British supply.
Gain 50 prestige and restore the core to full strength, fuel, and ammunition.
line.decision.choice.protect-civilian-co: Limit heavy fire and recognise hospital and civilian corridors.
Spend 125 prestige, give infantry and reconnaissance 15 experience, and restore the core to at least nine strength.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: Then put British approval on the battery maps. I want the men to know whose order reaches the street when a hospital and a roadblock share a wall.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Lieutenant-General Ronald Scobie
line.choice-a-1.text: They will know. Fire priorities are unified; local pauses require headquarters authority. End this quickly and there will be fewer streets requiring a second decision.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Lieutenant-General Ronald Scobie
line.choice-b-0.text: You are refusing weight that could shorten the battle. If an airfield remains closed because a corridor delayed you, the responsibility is yours.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-b-1.text: I'll take responsibility. Put the corridors on every gun map and send them to both sides. If a battery cannot confirm it has the markings, it waits.
